text: 【下周资本市场大事提醒】1、国家统计局将于10月14日09时30分公布9月CPI，8月同比上涨0.8%。同日一并公布9月PPI，8月同比3.8%。此外，9月金融数据或将在下周公布。2、海关总署将于10月14日中午公布9月进出口数据，8月出口同比增长25%、进口增长28.2%。3、本轮成品油调价窗口为10月15日24时，国内汽柴油零售价预计下调270元/吨。
text_en: [Key capital market events to watch next week] 1. The National Bureau of Statistics will release September CPI at 09:30 on October 14; August CPI rose 0.8% year-on-year. September PPI will also be released the same day; August PPI rose 3.8% year-on-year. In addition, September financial data may be released next week. 2. The General Administration of Customs will release September import and export data at noon on October 14; in August, exports rose 25% year-on-year and imports rose 28.2%. 3. The current round of refined oil price adjustment window is 24:00 on October 15, and domestic gasoline and diesel retail prices are expected to be cut by 270 yuan/ton.
